business_summary.text: Force Motors makes light commercial vehicles (Traveller, Urbania, Trax, Gurkha) and high-tech aggregates, including engines and axles for BMW and Mercedes-Benz India and Series 1600 engines through the Force MTU joint venture with Rolls-Royce Power Systems.

call_points.text: Company shifted to the new tax regime from Q2 of FY26.
Annualised ROIC was 23.72% in FY26, against 17.81% in FY25 and 14.02% in FY24.
The company shifted to the new tax regime during FY26, which the presentation flags against the PAT figures.
Project Digiforce is a ₹150 crore, two-year digital transformation programme across CRM, DMS, HRMS and dealer operations.
Digiforce covers integration across 200+ dealerships, 70 service centres and the global distributor network.
Project Lakshya, an HR transformation, includes a partnership with SP Jain School of Global Management for leadership programmes.
The Traveller is described as the market leader in its segment with over 70% share.

entities.name: Force MTU Power Systems Pvt. Ltd.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Automobiles > Passenger Cars & Utility Vehicles

operating_notes.text: Force Motors says the Traveller leads its segment with over 70% share and is India's most preferred ambulance platform.
The New Force Traveller N Range uses the BS-VI Stage 2 compliant FM 2.6 CR engine and is offered as ambulance, school bus and delivery van.
April 2026 total sales reached 3,113 units, impacted by supply chain constraints and transition to the New Force Traveller N Range.
May 2026 total sales were 2,614 units, reflecting a 15.35% YoY decline.
Force MTU Power Systems (51% Force Motors, 49% Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG) is described as the only plant in the world producing Series 1600 engines.
The Traveller is described as the market leader in its segment with over 70% market share.
Renewable electricity was 13.47% of usage in 2024-25 against a 50% target by 2027; GHG intensity fell 22% against a 50% reduction target by 2030.
Standalone annualised ROIC was 23.72% in FY26, up from 17.81% in FY25 and 14.02% in FY24.
Standalone FY26 operating cash flow was ₹971 Cr against capex of ₹367 Cr.
Project DigiForce is a ₹150 crore two-year programme covering 200+ dealerships and 70 service centres.

holders.name: Sundaram Mutual Fund - Sundaram Aggressive Hybrid Fund

timeline.summary: Force Motors completed the acquisition of Veera Tanneries Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary for ₹161.96 crore on April 23, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,549.84 Cr (+8.2% YoY), net profit ₹278.54 Cr (-35.9% YoY).
Force Motors launched the New Force Traveller N Range on 5 May 2026, moving its entire Traveller line to the new range from May 2026, with bookings from mid-May.
Force Motors reported April 2026 total sales of 3,113 units, down 4.36% YoY.
Force Motors reported May 2026 total sales of 2,614 units, down 15.35% YoY.

7 Aug 2026: Force Motors' Q1FY27 investor presentation showed standalone sales of ₹2,417 Cr (+6% YoY), PBT of ₹289 Cr (+1%) and PAT of ₹212 Cr (+14%), and disclosed a ₹150 Cr two-year Project DigiForce digitisation programme.
CRISIL reaffirmed CRISIL AA+/Stable/A1+ ratings on Force Motors' ₹765 Cr bank facilities.
